rows.ARS: Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
rows.Origin:
Bred by Wilhelm Kordes III (1953 - 2016) (Germany, 1999).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2002 as 'Bugatti'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve or purple blend. None to mild fragrance. 50 to 55 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Medium buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Large, matte foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 35" (90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .

rows.Notes: The seed parent has medium size, double, dark red blooms, while the pollen parent has light pink blooms.
